-- Phase 2: bodies

distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex distinct([1, 1]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

mix(x: int) -> int =
  ex mix(0) == mix(0)
  let r = x % 1000000007
  (r * 7919 + 12345) % 1000000007

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 1) == make_ids(3, 1)
  let base = mix(seed)
  let ids = par for i in range(0, n)
    base + i
  ids
